query: How have cart abandonment rates changed week over week this year?
baseline_sql:
```sql
WITH RECURSIVE weeks AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week_start
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        DATE_ADD(week_start, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
    FROM weeks
    WHERE week_start < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), '%Y-%m-%d')
),
weekly_carts AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(o.CreatedOnUtc) DAY, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.Id) AS completed_orders
    FROM Order o
    WHERE o.CreatedOnUtc >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
      AND o.OrderStatusId NOT IN (40, 50) -- cancelled/deleted examples
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(o.CreatedOnUtc) DAY, '%Y-%m-%d')
),
weekly_abandoned_carts AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(c.CreatedOnUtc - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(c.CreatedOnUtc) DAY, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.Id) AS abandoned_carts
    FROM ShoppingCartItem sci
    INNER JOIN Customer c
        ON c.Id = sci.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN OrderItem oi
        ON oi.ProductId = sci.ProductId
    LEFT JOIN Order o
        ON o.CustomerId = c.Id
        AND o.CreatedOnUtc >= sci.CreatedOnUtc
    WHERE sci.CreatedOnUtc >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
      AND o.Id IS NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.CreatedOnUtc - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(c.CreatedOnUtc) DAY, '%Y-%m-%d')
),
weekly_rates AS (
    SELECT
        w.week_start,
        COALESCE(a.abandoned_carts, 0) AS abandoned_carts,
        COALESCE(c.completed_orders, 0) AS completed_orders,
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(a.abandoned_carts, 0) /
            NULLIF(COALESCE(a.abandoned_carts, 0) + COALESCE(c.completed_orders, 0), 0) * 100,
            2
        ) AS abandonment_rate
    FROM weeks w
    LEFT JOIN weekly_abandoned_carts a
        ON a.week_start = w.week_start
    LEFT JOIN weekly_carts c
        ON c.week_start = w.week_start
)
SELECT
    week_start,
    abandoned_carts,
    completed_orders,
    abandonment_rate,
    ROUND(
        abandonment_rate -
        LAG(abandonment_rate) OVER (ORDER BY week_start),
        2
    ) AS week_over_week_change_pct_points
FROM weekly_rates
WHERE YEAR(week_start) = YEAR(CURDATE())
ORDER BY week_start;
```

```sql
WITH traffic_sources AS (
    SELECT
        o.Id AS OrderId,
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(o.CustomOrderNumber) LIKE '%google%'

                 OR LOWER(o.OrderNotes) LIKE '%gclid%' THEN 'Google Ads'
            WHEN LOWER(o.CustomOrderNumber) LIKE '%facebook%'
                 OR LOWER(o.OrderNotes) LIKE '%facebook ads%'
                 OR LOWER(o.OrderNotes) LIKE '%fbclid%' THEN 'Facebook Ads'
        END AS TrafficSource
    FROM Order o

            OR LOWER(o.OrderNotes) LIKE '%gclid%'
            OR LOWER(o.CustomOrderNumber) LIKE '%facebook%'

customer_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(ac.Source) LIKE '%google%' THEN 'Google Ads'
            WHEN LOWER(ac.Source) LIKE '%facebook%' THEN 'Facebook Ads'
        END AS TrafficSource,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ac.CustomerId) AS Visitors
    FROM ActivityLog ac
    WHERE 
        LOWER(ac.Source) LIKE '%google%'
        OR LOWER(ac.Source) LIKE '%facebook%'
    GROUP BY
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(ac.Source) LIKE '%google%' THEN 'Google Ads'
```

```sql
WITH product_margin AS (
    SELECT
        p.Id AS ProductId,
        p.Name AS ProductName,
        COALESCE(SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPriceInclTax), 0) AS Revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(oi.Quantity * p.Price), 0) AS ProductCost,

        NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPriceInclTax), 0), 0) AS Margin
    FROM OrderItem oi
    INNER JOIN Product p
        ON p.Id = oi.ProductId
    INNER JOIN [Order] o
        ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
    WHERE o.Deleted = 0
      AND o.OrderStatusId NOT IN (40)
    GROUP BY p.Id, p.Name
),
attribute_margin AS (
    SELECT
        'Manufacturer' AS AttributeType,
        CAST(m.Id AS CHAR) AS AttributeId,
        m.Name AS AttributeValue,
        AVG(pm.Margin) AS AvgMargin,
        COUNT(*) AS ProductCount
    FROM product_margin pm
    INNER JOIN Product p
        ON p.Id = pm.ProductId
    INNER JOIN Manufacturer m
        ON m.Id = p.ManufacturerId
    GROUP BY m.Id, m.Name

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Category' AS AttributeType,
        CAST(c.Id AS CHAR) AS AttributeId,
        c.Name AS AttributeValue,
        AVG(pm.Margin) AS AvgMargin,
        COUNT(*) AS ProductCount
    FROM product_margin pm
    INNER JOIN Product_Category_Mapping pcm
        ON pcm.ProductId = pm.ProductId
    INNER JOIN Category c
        ON c.Id = pcm.CategoryId
    GROUP BY c.Id, c.Name

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'ProductAttribute' AS AttributeType,
        CAST(pam.ProductAttributeId AS CHAR) AS AttributeId,
        pa.Name AS AttributeValue,
        AVG(pm.Margin) AS AvgMargin,
        COUNT(*) AS ProductCount
    FROM product_margin pm
    INNER JOIN ProductAttributeMapping pam
        ON pam.ProductId = pm.ProductId
    INNER JOIN ProductAttribute pa
        ON pa.Id = pam.ProductAttributeId
    GROUP BY pam.ProductAttributeId, pa.Name

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Store' AS AttributeType,
        CAST(psm.StoreId AS CHAR) AS AttributeId,
        s.Name AS AttributeValue,
        AVG(pm.Margin) AS AvgMargin,
        COUNT(*) AS ProductCount
    FROM product_margin pm
    INNER JOIN Product p
        ON p.Id = pm.ProductId
    INNER JOIN Product_Category_Mapping pcm
        ON pcm.ProductId = p.Id
    INNER JOIN Store s
        ON s.Id = p.Deleted
    GROUP BY s.Id, s.Name
),

        AttributeType,

        AvgMargin,
        ProductCount,

    FROM attribute_margin
    WHERE ProductCount >= 10
)
SELECT

    AttributeId,
    AttributeValue,
    ROUND(AvgMargin, 4) AS AverageMargin,
    ProductCount,
    ROUND(MarginZScore, 4) AS MarginCorrelationScore
FROM scored_attributes
ORDER BY ABS(MarginZScore) DESC
LIMIT 4;
```

query: Forecast next month's total revenue based on historical trends.
baseline_sql:
```sql
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m-01') AS revenue_month,
        SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPriceInclTax) AS total_revenue
    FROM OrderItem oi
    INNER JOIN `Order` o
        ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
    WHERE o.Deleted = 0
      AND o.OrderStatusId IN (
          30, -- Complete
          40  -- Closed
      )
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m-01')
),
trend_data AS (
    SELECT
        revenue_month,
        total_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_month) AS month_number
    FROM monthly_revenue
),
linear_regression AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS n,
        SUM(month_number) AS sum_x,
        SUM(total_revenue) AS sum_y,
        SUM(month_number * total_revenue) AS sum_xy,
        SUM(month_number * month_number) AS sum_x2
    FROM trend_data
),
forecast AS (
    SELECT
        (
            (
                (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) /
                NULLIF((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x), 0)
            ) * (n + 1)
            +
            (
                (sum_y - 
                    (
                        (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) /
                        NULLIF((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x), 0)
                    ) * sum_x
                ) / n
            )
        ) AS predicted_revenue
    FROM linear_regression
)
SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(
        DATE_ADD(MAX(revenue_month), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),
        '%Y-%m'
    ) AS forecast_month,
    ROUND(predicted_revenue, 2) AS predicted_total_revenue
FROM forecast
CROSS JOIN monthly_revenue;
```
